workload.parser_defect: A delayed progress line followed the valid Brutus JSON receipt, so the last-line parser reported zero. All three underlying receipt sets prove 25 of 25 passes. A RED/GREEN regression now selects the last JSON line instead.

conclusion.finding: The evidence is inconsistent with host CPU saturation or interface drop/error counters as the sole cause. It is consistent with kubelet/CRI streaming and runtime pressure amplified by many concurrent oc exec operations, while rhgnr1 also carries a separately material conntrack risk above 80 percent. These are strong diagnostic leads, not a proven single root cause.
conclusion.production_boundary: Arena remains not production-certified for network resilience. The 75 participant functions recovered and passed, which supports the internal pilot only with explicit controls and monitoring.

next_diagnostics: Repeat the 25-seat Multi-Agent participant wave through HTTPS routes while batching kubelet-dependent deep checks.

Compare kubelet runtime-operation latency and probe deadlines before, during and after the HTTPS-only wave.
